text: Write a PRD for a web app where students book lab slots. The users are students and lab staff. The problem: booking is done on paper and slots get double-booked. Must-have features: book a slot, cancel a slot, and see availability. Constraint: it must work on phones. Success measure: 80% of bookings are made without staff help.

@Requester Thanks, that is a clear brief. I need three more details before the plan can be written.
Please send these: What should the app be called? If you don't have a name yet, say so and I'll mark it as still to be decided; Your goal is that 80% of bookings are made without staff help. Over what period should we count that; What do lab staff do in the app? Pick all that apply.
Paused: Identity is waiting on the Requester (J2.a: not enough information to work yet). PRD v0 is in the preview. Answer Identity's question above to continue.
The app is called LabSlot. Count the 80% per term. Lab staff can view all bookings and cancel a booking for a student.
@Requester Thanks, I have everything I need for LabSlot. The team is now starting to write the plan document.
